tasks.label: Django: Start debug Compose
tasks.command: export HOST_WORKSPACE_FOLDER=$(docker inspect $(hostname) --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "${workspaceFolder}"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}') TRRF_HOST_PORT=8000 && test -n "$HOST_WORKSPACE_FOLDER" && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose-debug.yml up -d --build --force-recreate runserver && until docker exec trrf-runserver-1 grep -q ':162E .* 0A ' /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6; do printf 'Waiting for debugpy on port 5678...\n'; sleep 1; done

tasks.label: Django: Stop debug server
tasks.command: export HOST_WORKSPACE_FOLDER=$(docker inspect $(hostname) --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "${workspaceFolder}"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}') TRRF_HOST_PORT=8000 && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose-debug.yml stop runserver
